latest.title: The pinching constant for closed minimal submanifolds of high codimension in the sphere
latest.abstract: Let $M^n$ be a closed minimal submanifold in the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{n+q}$ with $n\geqslant 3$ and $q\geqslant 2$. Let $S$ be the squared length of its second fundamental form and $S_{\max}=\max_{p\in M}S(p)$. We prove that if $M$ is not totally geodesic, then \[ S_{\max}>\frac{2n}{3}+\frac{n-2}{182}. \]
latest.workSummary: 证明维数 n≥3、余维 q≥2 的非全测地闭极小子流形满足第二基本形式平方最大值严格大于 2n/3+(n−2)/182。
techniques: 缺陷与 Hessian 项的加权选择
Ricci 交换张量三次项的尖锐代数估计
latest.breakthrough: 给出高余维球面极小子流形的显式正间隙，较基准 2n/3 增加维数相关项。
latest.limitations: 无需 S 常值或法丛平坦假设，但只给第一间隙的下界；文中自然目标 S_max≥n 尚未达到。
latest.priorityReason: 定量间隙直接契合曲率刚性重点，结论具体，值得与既有夹逼界对照。
